g.data-label: Step 1: Inverse sRGB Gamma (Piecewise Linear / Power 2.4)
Step 2: Dark Object Subtraction (DOS) (Atmospheric Correction)
Step 3: SIFT Co-Registration (2500 Keypoints + Lowe's Ratio 0.75 + RANSAC Affine)
Step 4: ROI Cropping & Median Filtering (Per-channel cv2/scipy median blur)
Compute 8 Normalized Indices: NGRDI, ExG, ExR, VARI, MGRVI, NPCI, TGI, ExB

text.tspan: NGRDI, ExG, ExR, VARI, MGRVI, NPCI, TGI, ExB

g.data-label: Assemble 11-Channel Tensor Shape: (B, 11, H, W) float32 [R, G, B, 8 Spectral Indices]
4-Class Semantic Segmentation Mask 0: Soil | 1: Healthy | 2: Stressed | 3: Salt Patch
3 Patch-Level Multi-Task Labels Stress (3) | Moisture (3) | Yield (3)
11-Channel U-Net (ResNet18 Encoder + 4 Skip Connections)
Crop Canopy Soft Feature Gate X_gated = X ⊙ (0.25 + 0.75 · CropMask)
11-Channel Multi-Task CNN (ResNet18 or EfficientNet-B0 Backbone)
MultiTaskLoss (Inverse-Frequency Weighted Cross Entropy)
Multi-Task Grad-CAM Per-Head Attention Heatmaps (Target Conv: layer4 / features[-1])
Statistical Comparison Engine • Welch's Two-Sample t-test • One-Way ANOVAs (Plot & Date) • Cohen's d Effect Sizes • Temporal Linear Regression • Slope Comparison Z-test
Hybrid Recommendation Engine Tier 1: Deterministic Agronomic Rules Tier 2: 13-Dim Decision Tree (Trained on 600 domain rules) Secondary: Salinity Advisory (salt_ratio > 0.05)
